# Multi Color Printers

> Zanzibar's leading commercial printing company since 1995. Based in Mtoni, Zanzibar, Tanzania.

## About

Multi Color Printers is an award-winning commercial printing company specializing in high-quality print solutions for businesses across Zanzibar and Tanzania. Founded in 1995, the company has delivered over 30,000 projects for 700+ brands. In 2022, Multi Color Printers was named Best Commercial Print & Design Company in Tanzania by Acquisition International's Business Excellence Awards.

## Services

- Graphic Design (brand identity, marketing materials, typesetting, image manipulation)
- Digital Printing (HP Indigo 5500 — short runs, variable data, premium quality)
- Offset Printing (Heidelberg SpeedMaster — high-volume, consistent color)
- Packaging & Finishing (custom boxes, embossing, foiling, die-cutting)
- Business Cards
- Brochures & Flyers
- Posters & Banners
- Books & Booklets
- Magazines & Catalogs
- Letterheads & Envelopes
- Invoices & Receipt Books
- Calendars
- Stickers & Labels
- Wedding Cards & Invitations
- ID Cards & Certificates
- T-Shirt Printing
- Large Format Printing
- Rubber Stamps
